column1: # BabelSoft Data: Unicode per-version statistics (Version History)
# Source: computed from data/unicode/ (each version's own UnicodeData + C++ era
# rules from c/Unicode/VersionHistory.h).  One row per downloaded snapshot,
# labelled with its real minor version.
# Derived columns are computed at load time exactly as the C++
#   Added   = net change in Encoded vs the previous snapshot
#   2. date            - official release date of that version
#   3. total_planes    - number of planes (1 = BMP only, 17 = full)
#   4. planes_in_use   - planes that contain assigned characters
#   5. scripts         - number of scripts in that version
#   6. blocks          - number of blocks in that version
#   13. added          - characters added in that version (net)
#   14. removed        - characters removed in that version (net)
